floor.title: Floor setup
floor.subtitle: Lay out your dining areas and tables. Staff see changes on the Tables screen straight away.
floor.pickLocationBody: Each location has its own floor. Choose the one you want to set up.
floor.emptyBody: Start with a dining area such as Main Hall or Terrace, then add its tables.
floor.areaActive: Show this area on the Tables screen
floor.tableCodeHint: What your staff call it, such as T4 or Window 2.
floor.tableActive: Show this table on the Tables screen
floor.hiddenNote: A hidden table keeps its history but cannot be used for new guests.
floor.codeRequired: Give the table a name or number.
floor.seatsInvalid: Seats must be a whole number, 1 or more.
floor.removeBlocked: This table has past orders so it cannot be removed. Hide it instead.
floor.bulkInvalid: Enter a start number and a count between 1 and 60.
floor.bulkClash: These names already exist: {{codes}}. Change the prefix or start number.

menu.title: Menu
menu.subtitle: Your dishes, prices and tax. Waiters pick from this list when they take an order.
menu.emptyBody: Create a category such as Starters or Drinks, then add dishes to it.
menu.categoryActive: Show this category on the menu
menu.categoryRemoveBlocked: This category still has dishes. Move or remove them first, or hide the category instead.
menu.noItemsBody: Add the first dish with its price.
menu.priceInvalid: Enter the price as a number, for example 180 or 180.50.
menu.itemRemoveBlocked: This dish has past orders so it cannot be removed. Untick Available instead.
menu.variantsHint: Use this when one dish comes in sizes, such as Half and Full. The extra amount is added to the dish price.
menu.variantsAfterSave: Save the dish first, then you can add sizes.
menu.variantInvalid: Give the option a name and a valid amount, such as 20 or -10.
menu.taxBody: Create the tax rates you charge (for example GST 5%) and pick one on each dish. The first one you add becomes the default.
menu.noTaxYet: No tax rates yet. Dishes will be billed without tax until you add one.
menu.taxNameRequired: Give the tax rate a name.

addons.title: Add-ons
addons.body: Extras a guest can choose on a dish, such as extra cheese or spice level. Create the group here, then switch it on for each dish.
addons.name: Group name
addons.optionsAfterSave: Save the group first, then add its choices.
addons.optionRemoveBlocked: This choice has been ordered before, so it cannot be removed. Mark it unavailable later instead.
addons.maxInvalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
addons.optionInvalid: Give the choice a name and a valid amount, such as 20 or -10.
addons.removeBlocked: This group is used on past orders, so it cannot be removed.
addons.forDishHint: Tick the groups guests can choose from on this dish.

setup.title: Get your restaurant ready
setup.body: Three quick steps and your staff can start taking orders.

provision.title: New restaurant
provision.intro: This creates the restaurant workspace, its first location, the owner login and the modules in one go. The owner then sets up their own tables and menu.
provision.name: Restaurant name
provision.locationHint: Branch or outlet name. More can be added later.
provision.passwordHint: Generated for you. The owner must change it at first sign-in.
provision.modulesHint: The first three work together, so they always come as a set.
provision.working: Setting everything up. Please keep this window open.
provision.stopped: Something went wrong. Nothing is lost: retry continues from the step that failed.
provision.readyBody: Send these details to the owner. They can sign in right away and will see a short getting-started guide.
provision.shownOnce: The password is shown only now. Copy it before you close this window.

password.title: Change password
password.intro: You will be signed out everywhere and asked to sign in again with the new password.
password.same: Choose a password different from the current one.
password.wrongCurrent: That current password is not right.
password.failed: The password could not be changed. Try again.

gate.title: Set your own password
gate.body: You signed in with a temporary password ({{email}}). Choose a new one to continue. You will sign in again afterwards.

auth.passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.

profile.title: Restaurant profile
profile.subtitle: Your name, brand colour and the details printed on invoices.
profile.name: Display name
profile.colourHint: Buttons, highlights and glows use this colour for everyone in your restaurant. Dark colours switch button text to white.
profile.invoiceHint: Printed on bills. Leave blank to use the restaurant name.
profile.failed: The profile could not be saved.
